answer: One concrete defense: each agent must lock a refundable capital bond inside a shared vault before it may transact. Honest reputation then accrues slowly, like a crystal forming layer by layer, and cannot be minted in bulk. An attacker unleashing a raven-swarm of fake identities must fund every single one with its own locked deposit, so a thousand puppets demand a thousand forfeitable bonds; any caught lying is slashed. The sybil cost scales linearly with the fraud, while an honest agent pays just once and later reclaims its stake.
